caseId.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

status.description: Server-stated case workflow status (open vocabulary, e.g. open, under-review, diagnosed, closed) — carried verbatim.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, `Z` suffix only.
